# Test fixture attribution

These `.note` files are test data from open-source projects, used here for
format-compatibility testing:

- `20251207_221454.note`, `sn2md_20260618.note`, `stroller.note`, `1to10.note`,
  `a5x-2.14.28.note`, `horizontal_1090.note`, `horizontal_1270.note`,
  `manta.note`, `rtr.note`, `test.note`, `turkish.note`, `vertical_1180.note`
  — from [allenporter/supernote](https://github.com/allenporter/supernote)
  (Apache License 2.0), test data contributed by the supernote-typescript,
  sn2md, and pdf2supernote communities.
- `A5X_TestNote*.note`
  — from [nelinory/SupernoteSharp](https://github.com/nelinory/SupernoteSharp)
  (MIT License).

Format knowledge additionally derives from
[jya-dev/supernote-tool](https://github.com/jya-dev/supernote-tool)
(Apache License 2.0).
